title: Graduate civil or water engineer - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text:
Alluvium Group careers page (verified 4 Oct 2026): We recruit talented engineers, scientists and economists. Current Vacancies section: We're always looking for people to join our team who are excited and motivated to make a positive impact. Alluvium Consulting Melbourne office: Level 6, 176 Wellington Parade East, Melbourne VIC 3002 (contact page). Work focuses on catchments to coasts, urban stormwater and waterway engineering, modelling (12d, RORB, HEC-RAS, TUFLOW, MUSIC, AutoCAD), concept and detailed design.

Employer-published graduate application channel (Alluvium Consultant Engineering Graduate position description PDF, SA example still hosted on alluvium.com): Applications consisting of a short cover letter and CV, including working rights and GPA/WAM, can be sent to info@alluvium.com. Named contacts on related Melbourne stormwater recruitment used Lucie Bright and Stuart Cleven at @alluvium.com.au addresses.

This tick records a speculative expression of interest for graduate or early-career civil or water engineering support in the Melbourne urban water / waterways team, using the employer-published info@alluvium.com application inbox.
apply_instructions: Email short cover letter and CV to info@alluvium.com (employer-published application inbox on Alluvium graduate PD; careers page invites ongoing interest).
